what: A white band under each line of text unfolds from left to right in .8s (.25s apart per line, after .4s), and the same-color cover over the band retreats to the right .4s later, revealing the text — copy lines over a photo

options.delay: Band starts unfolding (s), default .4 — the cover comes .4 later than this
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Text line (child) — background color forms the strip
options.look: grow: No cover: a bar (the line’s ::before) grows from -5% on the left with scaleX 0→1 and transparent→opaque, and the whole line turns on text seconds later over dur — curve ease (default 0.22,1,0.36,1). Brand uses delay .3 · each .3 · dur .78 (30% of the 2.6s keyframes)
options.text: look: grow seconds before the text lights up after the band, default .2
options.look: rise: The band (the row’s ::before) unfolds from 0→1 on scaleX with the left as the axis (dur default .4 · each default .2 · delay default 0), and the text inside the row ([data-fx-part=text]) lines appear with no sequence, after text seconds (default 1), rising from one line height below over text-dur (default 1) — curve CSS ease. each-brand hero white-band three titles
options.text-dur: look: rise duration (sec) for the text to rise, default 1
options.[data-fx-part=text]: look: text inside the line in rise (optional — without it only the band unfolds)
options.look: drop: Vertical writing lines — the band extends from top to bottom over dur (default .5) (each default .2, delay default .1, curve ease default 0.76,0,0.24,1), and the cover retracts to the bottom edge over cover-dur (default .9) after cover seconds (default .8, a value counted from the start) (cover-ease default 0.165,0.84,0.44,1). The Brand variant uses the original Velocity values as they are
options.cover: look: in drop, the second at which the cover starts to lift (from the start), default .8
options.cover-dur: look: drop — duration in seconds for the cover to lift away, default .9
